meta.name: agent-orchestrator
meta.description:
Meta-agent skill for orchestrating complex tasks through autonomous sub-agents. Decomposes macro tasks into subtasks, spawns specialized sub-agents with dynamically generated SKILL.md files, coordinates file-based communication, consolidates results, and dissolves agents upon completion.

MANDATORY TRIGGERS: orchestrate, multi-agent, decompose task, spawn agents, sub-agents, parallel agents, agent coordination, task breakdown, meta-agent, agent factory, delegate tasks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂任务拆解给多个子智能体并行执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将大任务拆解并分配给多个子智能体协同完成。
copy.tagline_en: Decompose complex tasks and delegate to autonomous sub-agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down large tasks and coordinate multiple sub-agents.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 把一个复杂任务拆成多个小任务，然后创建多个子 AI 分别完成，最后汇总结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“分解任务”、“多智能体”、“并行任务”等关键词，或要求处理需要分工协作的复杂项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我分解这个市场分析报告任务，并分配子智能体。
say.note: Claude 会拆解任务并生成子智能体。

say.text: 启动多智能体协作，完成这个代码项目。
say.note: Claude 会创建多个子智能体并行工作。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to break down a complex task into subtasks, spawn multiple sub-agents to work on them independently, and consolidate the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'decompose task', 'multi-agent', 'parallel tasks', or request handling of a complex project that requires collaborative work.

say_en.text: Decompose this market analysis report task and assign sub-agents.
say_en.note: Claude will break down the task and generate sub-agents.

say_en.text: Start multi-agent collaboration to complete this code project.
say_en.note: Claude will create multiple sub-agents working in parallel.
